import openpyxl

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('output.xlsx')
ws = wb['Data to Import']

# Remove the last three characters from each postcode in column C (rows 2..max_row)
for row in range(2, ws.max_row + 1):
    cell = ws.cell(row=row, column=3)
    val = cell.value
    if isinstance(val, str) and len(val) > 3:
        cell.value = val[:len(val) - 3]

wb.save('output.xlsx')
print('done')
